messages.subject: Question about accessing local files.
parts:
Hello,

My name is Chungha Sung who is the one of members developing an R libarary called RIGHT for interactive visualization using JavaScript and HTML5 canvas. I think you may remember that JungHoon Lee asked a question about 'shiny.onInputchange'. Thanks to your suggestion, Our team developed a simple package and uploaded it on CRAN. Also, we are trying to refine it further to make a complete package, and we will promote it. 

While I am refining it, I am stuck on a problem about browser security. Our package should access local files for analysising data on JavaScript part. However, before changing local files security policy of browsers(e.g. add flag "--allow-file-access-from-files" on chrome. You can understand it by seeing this), an error occurs with "XMLHttpRequest cannot load file.." in JavaScript console.
I am using this code for access to local file.

var filePath = fileName;
xmlhttp = new XMLHttpRequest();
xmlhttp.open("GET", filePath, false);
xmlhttp.send(null);

The shiny packge may have same problems, I guess. Could you give me some suggestions or advice to solve this problem? Do you have any method to avoid it? 
If you have it, do you mind letting us know where the file access part is in your code?
If you know something, please help us to solve it. It will be very helpful.

Thank you very much in advance!

Sincerely,
Chungha Sung
